run_serial_io: run the d360 serial_io console script to handle serial communication for the Digit 360 platform
run_image_pub_opencv: run the d360 image_pub_opencv console script to publish images using OpenCV from the Digit 360 platform
run_image_pub_encode: run the d360 image_pub_encode console script to publish encoded images from the Digit 360 platform
run_audio_pub: run the d360 audio_pub console script to publish audio data from the Digit 360 platform
run_gas_pub: run the d360 gas_pub console script to publish gas sensor data from the Digit 360 platform
